_doc: Editing style presets. 'layout' picks the reframing engine in app/pipeline/reframe.py. Add a new preset by copying one block; only 'layout' must be a known engine.

face_track_zoom.name: Dynamic Face-Tracking Zoom
face_track_zoom.description: Smooth camera follows the active face, with punch-in zooms on high-energy words.

talking_head.name: Talking Head Clean Cut
talking_head.description: Locked-off crop on the speaker. Calm, clean, no camera moves.

podcast_split.name: Podcast Split-Screen
podcast_split.description: Two speakers stacked top and bottom. Falls back to face tracking when only one person is on screen.

gaming_fast.name: Gaming / Action Fast-Paced
gaming_fast.description: Gameplay on top, facecam on the bottom, quick zooms and a punchy hook line.

broll_split.name: Speaker + B-Roll Split
broll_split.description: Speaker framed on top, looping background B-roll clip on the bottom for retention.

blur_fill_reaction.name: Blurred Fill + Hook Title
blur_fill_reaction.description: Full 16:9 frame over a blurred backdrop with a hook-title card on top (stream-clip / reaction look).

center_crop.name: Simple Center Crop
center_crop.description: Fastest render. Plain center crop, no face tracking.
